sections.heading: Map Basics
items: The world is procedurally generated per save. Your islands will differ from other players'.
Use the map marker/waypoint system to flag resources, bosses, vendors, and points of interest.
Enable mini-map waypoint tracking in settings so you can sail toward icons without opening the full map.

sections.heading: Coordinate System
items: Each location has a coordinate. Share coordinates with friends or note them in a logbook.
Seeds drive layout. If you want the same world, share the seed value with friends before starting.

sections.heading: External Tools
items: Windrose Database (gaming.tools) – seed-based interactive map; upload a save file to auto-detect your seed.
Community maps – useful for seed-independent POI types (e.g., resource types per biome).

sections.heading: Sailing Tips
items: Use fast travel bells once crafted. They require setup but save huge sailing time.
Sail with the wind. Fighting headwind wastes supplies and exposes you longer.
Plot a chain route: hit resource islands on the way to a quest destination.
